sheppard-wallet.descriptionHtml:
Stylish, functional, and soft to the touch. The Sheppard is cut from supple sheep leather and closes with a button pocket that keeps your essentials secure — an easy everyday wallet that stays slim while carrying more than it looks.

  • Soft, lightweight sheep leather
  • 9 card slots
  • 2 ID windows with snap buttons
  • 2 bill slots for folded notes
  • Button pocket for small essentials

Handcrafted in Pakistan and backed by our lifetime craftsmanship warranty — organised carry without the bulk.

copy-of-mens-leather-fanny-pack.descriptionHtml:
Looking to carry your gear in a secure, convenient and comfortable way? Look no further than this Men's Leather Fanny Pack.
With seven individual pockets, there's room for your cell phone, keys, wallet, tissues and more. Ideal for Travelers that are wary about theft, there's even a secret pocket on the back for valuables like cash or your passport. This sling bag has multiple interior and exterior pockets - that means everything can have it's own place and you'll never be stuck for organization again.
The strap of this bum bag can go around your hip as a belt bag/waist bag or over your head as a cross body shoulder bag to make two convenient ways to carry. It's perfect for those occasions where you need to be hands-free, but you need take a bunch of stuff with you.
Features:

Made from premium Sheep leather
Total of 4 individual pockets for easy organization
One large main zipper compartment
2 Pockets on Front
One hidden rear zipper pocket
Adjustable strap with a premium easy-fasten clasp
Can be worn either on the waist or on the shoulder

DIMENSIONS: Length: 14.5 inches / Height: 5.5 inch

tp-the-nova-weaved-leather-wallet-clutch.descriptionHtml:
Elegance you can weave into any day. The Nova is a women's clutch and wallet handcrafted from premium leather with an exquisite handwoven exterior — a piece that moves effortlessly from work to a dinner party to a weekend out.

  • Premium handwoven leather — distinctive texture
  • Multiple compartments for cash, cards and essentials
  • Secure magnetic closure
  • Zippered pocket for loose change and small valuables

In Black, Blue, Tan and Brown. Handcrafted in Pakistan and backed by our lifetime craftsmanship warranty — sophistication that keeps your essentials in order.

kodo-vertical-2-0.descriptionHtml:
KODO Vertical 2.0 – Smart & Slim Leather Wallet for Effortless Access
Upgrade your everyday carry with the KODO Vertical 2.0, a premium top-grain leather wallet designed for style, functionality, and efficiency. Featuring a sleek, slim form factor, this vintage-inspired smart wallet is crafted to keep your essentials organized while maintaining a minimalist look.
🔹 Effortless Card Access – The pull strap mechanism allows quick and easy retrieval of frequently used cards.🔹 Smart Storage – Includes a front slip pocket for cash and additional slots for cards, ensuring everything stays in place.🔹 Premium Craftsmanship – Handcrafted from high-grade top-grain leather, offering durability and a refined aesthetic.🔹 Luxurious Feel – Lined with soft suede, enhancing both elegance and longevity.🔹 Compact & Travel-Friendly – Slim profile easily fits into pockets without bulk.
Perfect for modern professionals, minimalists, and travelers, the KODO Vertical 2.0 is your go-to wallet for style, convenience, and timeless durability.
🔹 Limited stock available – Order yours today!

the-ripper-case-by-kordovan.descriptionHtml:
Tired of carrying your cigarettes in your pocket?  Don't you wish there was an everyday alternative to eliminate all that hassle of destroyed cigarettes? Here it is, a unique new age Kordovan's Ripper Case that is stylish enough to wear every day. This dual compartment leather cigarette holder is convenient, looks great and will not get in the way of your daily life.
This luxury Ripper Cigarette Case by Kordovan is made from genuine cow leather, made to protect your Cigarette Box and Lighter. It is a fashionable and organized way to keep your smokes and lighter handy.
Features:

Genuine cow leather
Standard size cigarette box
Lighter slot available
Durable and Sleek design
Great for yourself use, or even give as a gift!

premium-saffiano-leather-wallet.descriptionHtml:
Saffiano is the leather of boardrooms — a fine cross-hatched matte texture that reads as quiet luxury from across the table. This modern bifold pairs it with a classic Kordovan logo plaque and a distinctive angular edge.

Inside: a large bill slot backed by discreet security slots, a transparent ID window, and card slots finished with the same topstitching and seaming precision as the exterior.

  • Matte saffiano leather with signature cross-hatch grain
  • Bifold design with angular edge detail
  • KORDOVAN logo plaque at front
  • Large interior bill slot + security slots
  • Transparent ID window · interior card slots
  • Topstitching + seaming details

Emerald Green is the statement — a colour you won't find in most wallet cases in Pakistan; Midnight Black is the executive default. Both handcrafted in Pakistan and backed by our lifetime craftsmanship warranty.

the-money-clip-minimal-wallet.descriptionHtml:
Minimal on the outside, magnetic on the inside. The Money Clip is a slim wallet in fine crazy horse cow leather with a powerful built-in magnetic clip that keeps your notes locked in place — no fumbling, no bulk, wherever life takes you.

  • 100% genuine crazy horse cow leather
  • 5 card slots + centre slot for bills or receipts
  • Magnetic money clip — holds up to 20 bills
  • Compact: 3.2″ × 4.8″

Handcrafted in Pakistan and backed by our lifetime craftsmanship warranty — stylish, secure, and slim.

the-luke-minimalist-wallet.descriptionHtml:
A wallet that carries more by standing tall. The Luke is a vertical billfold in full-grain cow leather — a format that fits 6–8 cards and up to 20 bills into a profile slimmer than most standard wallets. Draw it out and it reads as a statement piece, not a generic fold.

  • Full-grain cow leather — ages like a good whiskey
  • Holds 6–8 cards and up to 20 bills
  • Centre vertical slot for bills or receipts
  • Hand-stitched — seams that won't fray
  • Compact: 3.2″ × 4.3″ — formal or casual

Handcrafted in Pakistan and backed by our lifetime craftsmanship warranty — a genuine upgrade to your everyday carry.

the-armour-dual-mobile-wallet-with-notep.descriptionHtml:
When one pocket has to hold everything, the Armour answers. This long-format genuine cow leather wallet is really an organiser — two exterior phone slots, a built-in reading-glasses case, a notepad pocket with pen loop, plus the card slots and ID window you'd expect. Phone, cards, cash, glasses and a notepad, carried as a single piece.

  • 100% genuine cow leather, long format
  • Two exterior mobile phone slots
  • Built-in reading glasses case
  • Notepad pocket + pen loop
  • Interior card slots and ID window

Brown : handcrafted in Pakistan and backed by our lifetime craftsmanship warranty. The one for those who leave the house with more than just cards.
